releases.notes:
While New Sword Blocking reached end-of-life with v1.1.0, I will still provide support until July 24, 2025.

This is a very minor update, only indicating support for Java 1.21.8. If you’re already using the data pack version of v1.1.1, you don’t need to update.

### Changelog:

**Technical Changes:**

- Updated pack description & file name to include Java 1.21.8

**Technical Changes:**

- [Mod] Now explicitly depends on Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.8
  - Previously, the mod was marked as compatible with 1.21.5 and all future versions, which could cause issues with untested future game updates.

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.5 - 1.21.8
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5 - 1.21.8

### Support:

Please report any issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/New-Sword-Blocking/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod, requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
> .zip = Data pack

releases.notes:
### End of Life:

This is the last update for New Sword Blocking, adding support for Minecraft Java 1.21.6.

Maintaining multiple data packs takes time that I would rather focus elsewhere, and there are better alternatives to New Sword Blocking that I’d personally use instead:

- [Old Combat Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/oldcombat) – Fully customizable classic combat.
- [Sword Blocking](https://modrinth.com/datapack/sword_blocking) – Just sword blocking, nothing extra.
- [Vanilla Sword Blocking](https://modrinth.com/datapack/vanilla-sword-blocking) – Blocks damage and works with all swords.

Apologies for any inconvenience!

releases.notes:
### First full release!

There have been no changes since v1.0.0-pre2:

- Newly crafted swords can be used to block attacks by right-clicking while holding the sword in the main hand
- Swords block a percentage of damage from incoming attacks and lose durability points for each attack blocked, based on the material type of the sword:

| Sword | Damage Blocked | Durability Lost*
| :--: | :--: | :--: |
Wooden | 20% | 7
Golden | 25% | 9
Stone | 30% | 5
Iron | 40% | 4
Diamond | 50% | 3
Netherite | 60% | 2

\*per 10 damage blocked

**NOTE:**

The changes made by this pack do not apply to:

- Swords crafted before installation
- Swords dropped by mobs
- Swords traded by Villagers
- Swords found in loot chests
- Swords combined by crafting
- Swords taken from the Creative inventory
- Swords given through commands
- Modded or non-vanilla swords

### Compatibility:

This version is compatible with Minecraft Java 1.21.5.

### Support:

Please report any issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/New-Sword-Blocking/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod, requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
> .zip = Data pack
